_comment: Copilot CLI hooks (camelCase events). We subscribe to ALL available events and let the renderer (Show-CopilotToast.cs) decide what is toast-worthy -- it only raises a toast for 'attention needed' states (error; permission/idle on Claude) and stays silent for working/completed/exit. Each hook forwards stdin to Invoke-CopilotToast.ps1, which fire-and-forget launches the renderer so the session is never blocked. NOTE: preToolUse is awaited by the CLI (it can carry a permission decision); our launcher returns immediately without one, so the per-tool overhead is just a quick process spawn. ${PLUGIN_ROOT} is the installed plugin directory.
